Introduction


The Department of Administrative Services (DAS) is accepting applications for an anticipated opening for an ADA Specialist (Human Resources Specialist) in Hartford. 


WHAT WE CAN OFFER YOU

  • Visit our State Employee Benefits Overview page!
  • A healthy work/life balance to all employees.

    POSITION HIGHLIGHTS
    • Full-time, 40 hours/week.
    • Monday - Friday, 8 hours per day.
    • Centrally located in Hartford, CT (450 Columbus Boulevard).
    • Hybrid work schedule (combination of in-office and telework in accordance with the Telework Policy).

      THE ROLE
      The ADA Specialist will support state employees by guiding them through the accommodation process under the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) and the Pregnant Workers Fairness Act (PWFA). You will manage a caseload of accommodation requests and facilitate the interactive process, in compliance with state and federal requirements. This position reports to the ADA Manager (Principal Human Resources Specialist).

      As part of the ADA Team, you will work both independently and collaboratively with Shared Services colleagues, agency managers, and Human Resources Business Partners. You will provide clear guidance and excellent customer service to help employees and managers understand their rights and responsibilities. Many cases involve navigating intersections with other laws, including the Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA) and workers’ compensation. The ADA Specialist will interpret supporting documentation and provide clear guidance to employees and management throughout the interactive process. 

      In this role, you can expect to:
      • Manage the intake of accommodation requests, evaluate eligibility, and issue required notices and determinations.
      • Conduct thorough review of medical and supporting documentation and follow up when clarification is needed.
      • Maintain clear, comprehensive documentation throughout the accommodation process.
      • Partner with agency HR Business Partners to evaluate potential accommodations.
